documents.name: Three classic passes — Grimsel, Furka & Susten
documents.summary: A 131 km Swiss alpine loop from Meiringen linking the Grimsel, Furka and Susten passes in one continuous high-mountain circuit.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The route combines three major Swiss passes into one coherent circuit, moving through lake-and-waterfall country, glacier-facing high alpine terrain and long engineered mountain-road descents without requiring three separate out-and-back detours.

coverImage.alt: The Furka Pass road descending through high alpine terrain as seen from the Grimsel side.
